description: Source code for handling column display and formatting in a git-related project, including layout calculations, configuration parsing, and subprocess management for column filtering.

methods.name: item_length
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a string in UTF-8 characters, stripping ANSI escapes.

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Calculates the number of rows and columns for displaying a list in a table format based on width and padding.

methods.name: compute_column_width
methods.description: Determines the maximum width for each column based on the list of items.

methods.name: shrink_columns
methods.description: Reduces column widths by removing rows to fit within total width constraints.

methods.name: display_plain
methods.description: Displays list items in plain format with indentation and newline.

methods.name: display_cell
methods.description: Prints a single cell in the table with proper spacing and line breaks.

methods.name: display_table
methods.description: Displays a list of strings as a formatted table with columns or rows.

methods.name: print_columns
methods.description: Main entry point to print a list of strings in column format based on configuration.

methods.name: finalize_colopts
methods.description: Adjusts column options based on whether output is a TTY or pager is in use.

methods.name: parse_option
methods.description: Parses individual column options from command-line arguments.

methods.name: parse_config
methods.description: Parses a string of comma or space-separated options to configure column display.

methods.name: column_config
methods.description: Configures column options based on configuration variables.

methods.name: git_column_config
methods.description: Handles configuration for column display, including 'ui' and command-specific options.

methods.name: parseopt_column_callback
methods.description: Callback for parsing command-line options related to column display.

methods.name: run_column_filter
methods.description: Starts a subprocess to filter column output, configuring arguments and pipes.

methods.name: stop_column_filter
methods.description: Stops the column filter subprocess and restores stdout.
